SELECT
o.*,
c.user_id AS customer_id, c.user_name AS customer_name, c.user_email AS customer_email, c.user_phone AS customer_phone, c.wallet_balance,
p.product_name, p.product_description, p.product_price, p.product_status
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN customers c ON o.user_id=c.user_id
INNER JOIN products p ON o.product_id=p.product_id
WHERE o.order_id=#{orderId}

SELECT
o.*,
c.user_id AS customer_id, c.user_name AS customer_name, c.user_email AS customer_email, c.user_phone AS customer_phone, c.wallet_balance,
p.product_name, p.product_description, p.product_price, p.product_status
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN customers c ON o.user_id=c.user_id
INNER JOIN products p ON o.product_id=p.product_id
WHERE o.user_id=#{customerId}
ORDER BY o.order_date DESC

SELECT
o.*,
c.user_id AS customer_id, c.user_name AS customer_name, c.user_email AS customer_email, c.user_phone AS customer_phone, c.wallet_balance,
p.product_name, p.product_description, p.product_price, p.product_status
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN customers c ON o.user_id=c.user_id
INNER JOIN products p ON o.product_id=p.product_id
WHERE p.user_id=#{sellerId}
ORDER BY o.order_date DESC

SELECT
o.*,
c.user_id AS customer_id, c.user_name AS customer_name, c.user_email AS customer_email, c.user_phone AS customer_phone, c.wallet_balance,
p.product_name, p.product_description, p.product_price, p.product_status
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN customers c ON o.user_id=c.user_id
INNER JOIN products p ON o.product_id=p.product_id
LEFT JOIN payments pay ON o.order_id=pay.order_id
WHERE o.user_id=#{customerId}
AND pay.order_id IS NULL

INNER JOIN products p ON o.product_id=p.product_id
